name: flowforge
description: Queue, workflow and asset workspace for Google Flow (independent third-party tool).

scripts.build: npm run build -w @flowforge/core && npm run build -w @flowforge/extension && npm run build -w @flowforge/agent
scripts.test: npm test -w @flowforge/core && npm test -w @flowforge/extension && npm test -w @flowforge/agent && npm test -w @flowforge/license-server
scripts.build:dev: npm run build:dev -w @flowforge/extension && npm run build -w @flowforge/agent
